summary: Phase 1 delivery for Merrakii+ DESSS — eight build levels over twelve weeks.

productOverview.title: Summary
productOverview.body: Maple AI is building Merrakii+ as one responsive web application (mobile through desktop) that helps students explore careers, understand their journey, and take the next step — while giving Merrakii an admin console to manage content, users, courses, resources, and financials. Phase 1 covers the scoped pages and backend in Statement of Work V2 (aligned to Merrakii_pages_inscope.xlsx): about 40 in-scope items across student-facing pages, admin panel, and platform/backend — including search and career journey, deep profiling, payments (Razorpay), student dashboard, and AWS deployment through go-live.

pillars.name: Student-facing experience
pillars.detail: Home search, career journey map, deep profiling, journey payment, student dashboard (overview, my journey, journey report, courses, resources, notifications), course detail/enrolment/payment, and support pages (About, Contact, FAQs, policies).

pillars.name: Admin portal
pillars.detail: Career library CMS, user management, service knowledge, courses, resources, and financials overview — so Merrakii can operate the product without engineering for every content change.

pillars.name: Backend & go-live
pillars.detail: Platform APIs, access and security, search and personalisation foundations, Razorpay integration, AWS staging and production, testing/UAT, and handover runbooks.

timeline.label: Build levels (L1–L8)
timeline.overallLabel: L1 Core student journey in progress · week 2 of 2

levels.name: Core student journey
levels.detail: Website architecture, home search, career library, career journey map, deep profiling, journey payment, student dashboard overview and my journey.

levels.name: Report, courses & enrolment
levels.detail: Career journey report, course list, course detail, course enrolment and course payment.

levels.name: Career library, users & knowledge CMS
levels.detail: Admin career library CMS, user management, and service knowledge base.

levels.name: Courses, counsellors, resources & financials
levels.detail: Admin operations: course management, counsellor management, resources library, and financials overview.

levels.name: Additional functionality on L1–L2
levels.detail: Enrichment, payment and trust pages layered onto the student journey: notifications, resources, support pages and policies.

levels.name: Platform foundations (non-UI) — includes AWS staging/production
levels.detail: Platform APIs, access and security, search and personalisation foundations, Razorpay integration, AWS staging and production, CI/CD, backups and monitoring.

levels.name: Testing
levels.detail: End-to-end tests on staging, defect fixes, performance and security checks, UAT support and written approval.

levels.name: Go Live
levels.detail: Production cutover on AWS, hypercare, handover runbooks and environment guides.

artifacts.name: Statement of Work V2 (active — scoped pages)

requirements.title: Careers and Colleges as blocks
requirements.detail: Please clarify whether Careers and Colleges should be treated as blocks. Should they behave like blocks such as Academics and Skills, including being divided and mapped across milestones, or should they be modelled separately?

blockers.title: Business rule for blocks and requirements across milestones
blockers.detail: We need to finalize how blocks and their requirements should be selected and displayed across milestones, especially for milestones the user has already crossed. For example, if a student is currently in Class 12 and searches for a Lawyer journey, how should we determine which blocks and requirements from Class 9, Class 10, and Class 11 are shown? Please confirm the business rule or criteria for filtering these past-milestone blocks and requirements.

blockers.title: Entities metadata
blockers.detail: We need to define the metadata and associated information for Libraries, Goals, Milestones, Blocks, Requirements, Services, and Programs that will be used by the application and displayed on the UI.

blockers.title: Additional career journeys
blockers.detail: We need to define the two additional journey types: Degree Journey and Skill Journey.
